parameters.query:
=SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) AS results
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.total_amount, o.currency, o.carrier, o.tracking_number, o.estimated_delivery, o.items, o.service_type, c.full_name
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE o.order_number ILIKE '%' || '{{ ($json.ai_output?.entities?.order_number || $json.entities?.order_number || ($json.customer_message || '').match(/(?:ord|srv)-\d+/i)?.[0] || 'UNKNOWN').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' || '%'
     OR (c.phone_number IS NOT NULL AND c.phone_number != '' AND c.phone_number = '{{ ($json.customer?.phone_number || 'NONE').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
     OR (c.telegram_id IS NOT NULL AND c.telegram_id != '' AND c.telegram_id = '{{ ($json.customer?.telegram_id || 'NONE').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
  ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t;
